---

**Every field here is optional.** One sentence saying what you could not do is a real report, and we would much rather have that than nothing. Delete whatever does not apply.

**What were you trying to do?**
The task in your own words — "pay my receipt", "find a member", "sign up for an activity", "show my card at the door".

**Where were you?**
The page or URL, and whether you were in the admin panel or in the member portal.

**What happened, and what did you expect instead?**

**How were you using it?**
- Browser and version:
- Operating system:
- Assistive technology, if any — name, version, and any settings that matter:
- How you were navigating: keyboard only / mouse or trackpad / touch / voice / switch / something else:

**Which install?**
- memship version (shown in the app):
- Interface language: Spanish / Catalan / English

**Anything else**
A screenshot or a recording if it helps — **neither is required**, and a report without one is not worth less.

---

Two things you do not need to do: **you do not need to pick a severity** — maintainers set that during triage — and **please do not describe your disability.** It is not needed to fix a bug and we would rather not have it in a public issue.

If filling in this form is itself the barrier, email <marcandreuf@gmail.com> with `memship accessibility` in the subject and we will open the issue for you.

[ACCESSIBILITY.md](https://github.com/marcandreuf/memship/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md) covers what happens after you post, and lists what is already known to be broken — worth a glance in case yours is on it, though a duplicate costs nothing.
